cast.characterName: ジャンカルロ･ブルボン･デル･モン
cast.originalCharacterName: ジャンカルロ･ブルボン･デル･モン

segments.text: A man so lucky, he goes by the nickname of "Lucky Dog". Outwardly unkempt and rarely seen wihtout a cigarette wedged between his lips, Gian always carries around his absolute favourite food, chewing gum. Laidback, he doesn't care about about his appearance and has poor personal hygiene. Gian is not the type to dwell on the little things, but he does what he has to do efficiently. Involved in the mafia since his youth, Gian has been in and out of jail. In fact, he is so skilled in escaping prison (and so frequently imprisoned), that he regards it as a hobby.

He appears to be easy to fool, but in actuality, Gian is quite perceptive and sharp. His one critical weakness would be his emotionality. Gian's favourite colour is yellow and his favourite food is gum. In his spare time, Gian likes to listen to the radio or break out of jail. His CR-5 tattoo is located on his left clavicle.

cast.characterName: ジュリオ・ディ・ボンドーネ
cast.originalCharacterName: ジュリオ・ディ・ボンドーネ

segments.text: A highly accomplished assassin hailing from a wealthy and influential family, Giulio is silent and shows little interest in anyone or anything. However, his love of blood, killing and his proficiency with knives has earned him the nickname of "Mad Dog" by those who witnessed him at work. Other than killing, Giulio shows an uncanny interest in Giancarlo, to the point of obsession; behaving differently around him.

Though a polite and tender sweet lover with many juvenile characteristics, he is a highly dangerous (and mentally imbalanced) blood fetishist and necrophiliac. His favourite colour is red and his favourite food is is ice cream. Giulio's CR-5 tattoo is located on his left flank.

cast.characterName: イヴァン・フィオーレ
cast.originalCharacterName: イヴァン・フィオーレ

segments.text: Accomplished for his young age, Ivan is the newest addition to the CR-5 that is aiming to become its leader. As a result, he is completely against Gian possibly becoming the next leader. There are members that don't trust him simply because Ivan isn't Italian (he's supposedly an Irish-American). His blunt, direct, foul-mouthed and plain rude attitude doesn't help his relations with his fellow members, and he isn't well-liked.

Usually, Ivan is aggressive and domineering towards those weaker than him. Even so, he is easily picked on by Gian. Due to an incident in the past, he has an acute mistrust of most he meets. As a result, he is self-sufficient and highly independent. He adores his Mercedes Benz. Ivan's favorite color is white, and his favorite foods are hotdogs and lollipops. His hobby is driving. Ivan's CR-5 tattoo is located on his right shoulder.

cast.characterName: ルキーノ・グレゴレッティ
cast.originalCharacterName: ルキーノ・グレゴレッティ

segments.text: Charming, good-looking and wealthy, Luchino is full of confidence and pride. He is a woman (especially blondes) and gambling lover with expensive tastes.

His tendency to order people around comes from his confidence in himself, as well as what he perceives to be the right cause of action. He seems to be impulsive because of his interests, but in actuality, Luchino thinks before he moves ahead.

His favorite colors are black, pink and white, and his favorite foods are minestrone and risotto. When not working, Luchino likes to spend money. Apparently, he arranged the "mafia" outfits for his colleagues. His CR-5 tattoo is located on his right hand.

cast.characterName: ベルナルド・オルトラーニ
cast.originalCharacterName: ベルナルド・オルトラーニ

segments.text: The oldest out of the CR-5 leaders, Bernardo is clever, efficient and highly organized, making him a valued member. His perverted nature and jocularity does not get in the way of his proficiency at his job. He has known Giancarlo for a while, and they get along quite well. Sharing a similar sense of humor, Bernardo likes to call Giancarlo "darling" (and Giancarlo calls Bernardo "honey") in jest. To everyone that watches Giancarlo and Bernardo together, they get the impression that the two are very close. Bernardo is supportive of Giancarlo possibly becoming the next leader.
His favorite color is purple, and his favorite food is coffee. In his spare time, Bernardo likes to fix and play with machinery. His CR-5 tattoo is located on his left wrist.

cast.characterName: バクシー・クリステンセン
cast.originalCharacterName: バクシー・クリステンセン

segments.text: Even at a young age, Bakshi is ranked fairly high in the CR:5's rival gang, the Grave Diggers. With his unabashed bloodlust, Bakshi relishes in tormenting and violence, making him feared by both his enemies and his allies. Crude, rude and unhinged, Bakshi pretty much does whatever floats his boat- to the point that he sometimes even ignores his boss (the leader of the Grave Diggers) and acts on his own.

Despite his wild appearance, Bakshi takes good care of himself (refusing to use drugs, drinking heavily, smoking, etc.) and is smarter than he looks, if not, sly. He is highly independent and competent at following through with his boss' orders (when he decides to). As a result of his independent spirit and self-confidence, Bakshi hardly has an underlings and moves on his own. Bakshi is a Grave Diggers member that the CR:5 learns to not take lightly. In Gian Carlo's Lucky Happy Life, it is shown that he has a fondness for cats. His signature weapons are his two shotguns.
